responsibility: This file overrides parts of the generic MIPS scheduler with the older pipeline timings for the R3000 and TX39/R3900 class processors. It provides simple reservation latencies for loads, integer multiply/divide, and basic floating-point move/add/multiply/divide operations, giving GCC enough target-specific timing information to schedule code for these early MIPS I-era cores without the more detailed DFA resource models used by newer processors.
